msg: Hola, buen día. Somos un grupo de 7 amigas de Bogotá. Tres ya tenemos el Open Water, dos quieren probar el minicurso y dos prefieren snorkel. ¿Cuánto saldría por persona saliendo desde Cartagena y hay descuento por grupo?
reply:
¡Hola! 🪸 Soy *Coral*, de *Diving Planet* — buceamos todo el año en las Islas del Rosario, saliendo desde Cartagena o desde las propias islas. 🌊

¡Buen día! ¡Qué chévere plan para las siete! Sí, pueden combinar buceo certificado, minicurso y snorkel en la misma salida; según la operación, podrían ir en la misma lancha o dividirse por actividad.

Te dejo a continuación los precios por persona para el minicurso y el snorkel saliendo desde Cartagena. Para las tres buzas certificadas, desde Cartagena la salida es de mínimo dos inmersiones.

Sí hay descuento de grupo para grupos de cinco o más: aplica al minicurso y al snorkel, y deben solicitarlo antes de pagar.

*Precios por persona* (online · normal):
*Desde Cartagena* — lancha desde el Muelle de la Bodeguita · con almuerzo
• Minicurso de Buceo: 655.000 COP · 727.000 COP
• Tour de Snorkeling: 448.000 COP · 497.000 COP
*Ya en las Islas del Rosario* — recogida en tu hotel si tiene acceso por lancha · sin almuerzo
• Minicurso de Buceo: 475.000 COP · 528.000 COP
• Tour de Snorkeling: 150.000 COP · 167.000 COP

No hay descuento ni tarifa especial por ser colombiano: el precio es el mismo, solo cambia la moneda (COP).

Entonces, ¿saldrías *desde Cartagena* (Muelle de la Bodeguita)? 🚤

msg: Hello. My wife and I arrive on a cruise ship in Cartagena on March 3rd, docking at 7:00 am and we must be back on board by 5:00 pm. We would both like to snorkel. Is that doable? We are from Canada.
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

The snorkeling trip from Cartagena returns to the dock at about 4:15 p.m., so it would be too tight for a 5:00 p.m. all-aboard time. The trip departs at 8:00 a.m. from Muelle de la Bodeguita, and the departure time can’t be moved earlier. Since you dock at 7:00 a.m., getting to the meeting point in time may also be difficult.

So, would you leave *from Cartagena* (Muelle de la Bodeguita)? 🚤

¡Hola! 🪸 Soy *Coral*, de *Diving Planet* — buceamos todo el año en las Islas del Rosario, saliendo desde Cartagena o desde las propias islas. 🌊

Para reservar saliendo desde las islas, primero necesitas tener el hotel y decirnos cuál, porque la recogida se coordina allí. Cuando lo tengas, podemos avanzar con la reserva de las 2 inmersiones.

Si eliges una casa, un Airbnb o un hotel fuera de nuestra lista, un asesor debe confirmar la recogida antes de reservar y pagar.

Siempre hay disponibilidad: operamos todos los días, festivos incluidos, salvo el 25 de diciembre y el 1 de enero; si el mar no está apto, la salida se reprograma.

¿Quieres que te pase con un asesor para revisar esa opción?

msg: Sí, saldría desde las islas. Pero el hotel lo decidiré más adelante y me preocupa quedarme sin plaza para bucear. ¿De verdad no se puede dejar reservado ya y os digo el hotel en cuanto lo tenga? Si hace falta, pago ahora.
reply:
Para reservar saliendo desde las islas, sí necesitas tener primero el hotel y decirnos cuál, porque la recogida se coordina allí. Aunque pagues ahora, no podemos dejar la reserva hecha sin ese dato; primero asegura el hotel y luego coordinamos el buceo. Así evitamos que la recogida no sea posible o que termines saliendo desde Cartagena.

Para reservar desde las islas necesito saber en qué hotel te alojas: la recogida se coordina allí y, si el hotel cambia o se cancela, cambia también tu plan. Si aún no lo tienes, resérvalo primero y escríbeme con el nombre; entonces seguimos con la reserva. 🌊

Además de nuestra base (Hotel San Pedro de Majagua y Hotel Cocoliso, en Isla Grande), otros hoteles del área con acceso marítimo son Rosario de Mar, Secreto, Ubuntu, Mulata, Eco Hotel Las Palmeras y Pao Pao. El alojamiento no está incluido: se reserva directamente con el hotel.

msg: Solo yo. ¿A qué hora me recogerían en el Cocoliso y tengo que llevar algo? Gracias.
reply:
En Cocoliso te recogerían entre las 9:30 y las 9:45. Ten listo tu carné de buceo y lleva bañador, toalla, crema de sol, gafas de sol y ropa cómoda; el equipo de buceo está incluido. Después de bucear, espera al menos 18 horas antes de tomar un vuelo.

También necesitas:
• Estar listo a las 9:30 en tu hotel
• Si llevas más de 2 años sin bucear, normalmente se requiere un refresh; los buzos muy experimentados (500+ inmersiones, Dive Master) los revisa un asesor del equipo. Si ya hiciste un refresh o un PADI ReActivate en otro centro, cuenta como tu refresh y puedes bucear directamente.
• Para procesar el seguro, debes completar el formato que te enviamos en el correo de confirmación.
• Edad mínima: desde los 10 años.
• Para las salidas de buceo recreativo, el refresher y los cursos para buzos ya certificados (Advanced, Rescue, Divemaster y especialidades), debes presentar tu carne de buzo certificado. Puedes enviarnos una foto del carné antes o mostrarlo el día de la actividad.

¿Han pasado *más de 2 años* desde tu última inmersión?

msg: Hi there! We're a family from Canada staying in Cartagena next month. My wife and I are both Advanced Open Water divers, and we have two kids, aged 11 and 7. What could each of us do on a day trip from Cartagena, and how much would it cost?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

That sounds like a lovely family day in the Rosario Islands! From Cartagena, the day trip includes round-trip boat transport, lunch, and a return to Cartagena that afternoon.

- **You and your wife:** As certified divers, you can each do **Fun Dives—2 guided reef dives**. You’ll need to bring your certification cards. - **Your 11-year-old:** They can snorkel, or try the **Dive Mini Course**—pool practice and one ocean dive with a PADI instructor. Diving activities start at age 8 for Bubble Makers and age 10 for the Mini Course.

The children must be accompanied by a responsible adult. I’m leaving the prices below as well.

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day): 178 USD · 197 USD
• Snorkeling Tour: 126 USD · 140 USD
• Dive Mini Course: 183 USD · 204 USD

Would you like the booking links for the options you’re considering?

rag.answer:

msg: That's better, thank you. So my wife and I would do the 2 dives, our son the mini course and our daughter the snorkeling. If both of us are diving, who stays with our daughter while she's snorkeling, given she has to be accompanied? And do we all go on the same boat?
reply:
Your daughter must be accompanied by a responsible adult while snorkeling, so your wife wouldn’t be able to leave her unattended while diving. Snorkeling takes place in a different area from the dive sites. If there are few people, everyone travels on the same boat; otherwise, the group is split by activity. The team can help confirm how to arrange supervision for your family.

Has it been *more than 2 years* since any diver in the group last dived?

msg: Good afternoon. I am from Germany and I hold an Open Water certification, although I have not dived for three years. I am staying in Getsemaní and I would like to dive next Wednesday. My flight home leaves on Thursday at 22:00. Is this possible, and what would you recommend?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

Good afternoon! A refresher is a great way to get comfortable again after three years without diving. Since you’re certified, the refresher is the right option rather than the beginner mini-course.

A daytime refresher from Cartagena ends around 12:00–1:00 p.m. on Wednesday. You must wait at least 18 hours from your last dive before flying, so a Thursday 22:00 flight meets that interval. The boat returns to Cartagena around 4:15 p.m.; the meeting point is Muelle de la Bodeguita at 8:00 a.m.

You can choose Wednesday and book here: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/minicurso-de-buceo/2?language=en

The booking system closes at 4:30 p.m. the day before, so Wednesday bookings need to be made before then. Please bring your certified diver card.

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• Dive Mini Course: 183 USD · 204 USD

There is always availability: we operate every day, including public holidays, except December 25 and January 1; if sea conditions are not safe, the trip is rescheduled.

How many people would this be for: just you, or more? 😊

msg: Good, thank you. Two last questions: do you pick me up in Getsemaní or how do I reach the dock, and do I have to bring my certification card or fill in any forms for these two days?
reply:
There’s no hotel pick-up in Getsemaní. Please make your own way to **Muelle de la Bodeguita** for the **8:00 a.m.** meeting; it’s about five minutes from the historic center. Ground transport to the dock isn’t included. At entrance 3, ask for **Diving Planet**: [map](https://www.google.com/maps/place/Muelle+de+la+Bodeguita/@10.4199447,-75.5537609,828m/data=!3m2!1e3!4b1!4m6!3m5!1s0x8ef62f753729822d:0x1bbcdd8224d0eaaf!8m2!3d10.4199447!4d-75.551186!16s%2Fg%2F113gzkckf?entry=ttu)

Please bring your **certified diver card**—you can show it on the day. For the refresher, complete the **course medical form**: [form](https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-curso-en-espanol) (in Spanish). You’ll also need to complete the insurance form sent in your booking confirmation email. There’s no theory to do beforehand; you’ll cover it with the instructor on the refresher day.

You'll also need:
• If it's been more than 2 years since your last dive, a refresher is normally required; very experienced divers (500+ dives, Dive Master) are reviewed by a member of our team. If you already did a refresher or a PADI ReActivate at another centre, it counts as your refresher and you can dive directly.
• After diving, wait at least 18 hours before flying
• Minimum age: 10 and over.
• For recreational dive outings, the refresher and the courses for already-certified divers (Advanced, Rescue, Divemaster and specialties), you must present your certified diver card. You can send us a photo of it beforehand or show it on the day of the activity.
• What to bring: swimsuit, towel, sunscreen, sunglasses and comfortable clothes. Diving or snorkeling gear is included in dive trips, the mini-course, snorkeling and PADI courses; the Divemaster uses their own gear.

reply:

¡Qué buen plan para disfrutar dos días de buceo en las Islas del Rosario! Para dos días desde Cartagena, pueden elegir entre el paquete de **4 inmersiones diurnas** o el de **5 inmersiones, que incluye una nocturna**.

Como son 6, aplica el **10% de descuento para grupos de 5 o más**, además del **10% online**. Deben pedir el descuento de grupo al equipo **antes de pagar**; no se aplica automáticamente.

msg: Hey! I'm an American diver, Advanced Open Water. I'm renting a house on Airbnb on Isla Grande next week, it's called Villa Marea. I'd like to do two dives. Can you pick me up there? How does that work?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

That sounds like a great plan! For two certified dives while you’re on Isla Grande, pick-up is between **9:30 and 9:45 a.m.** if your accommodation has boat access. The boat takes you to our base for equipment setup and **two open-water dives**, then returns you to your hotel around **12:00–1:00 p.m.** Pick-up and drop-off are included at no extra charge.

Because Villa Marea is an Airbnb and isn’t on our listed hotels, a team advisor needs to confirm the pick-up logistics before you book and pay. Depending on its maritime access, the boat may come directly to the house or you may need to meet at a nearby dock. Would you like me to connect you with a team advisor to confirm Villa Marea’s pick-up?

Diving Planet policies:
- Wait at least 18 hours to take a flight after recreational diving. 12 hours minimum after the mini course (only for non-certified divers). The refresher is also 18 hours: it is for certified divers, even though it is booked as the mini course. The hours count from the last dive, not from the return to Cartagena. The mini course dive ends around 12:00 (noon): its 12 hours count from then. If the last dive is a daytime one, the refresher's included (activities end around 12:00-1:00 p.m.), you can fly from 7:00 a.m. the next day; after the mini-course, from midnight that same day. If the last dive is a night dive, the hours count from it. A flight the next day at 7:00 a.m. or later IS fine: they can dive the day before, and that day's return time to Cartagena changes nothing. For a certified diver, a flight on the SAME day as the dive NEVER works, whatever the time, even at night: with a flight on Sunday night, the last dive must be on Saturday at the latest; the boat being back before they leave does not fix it. If they say they leave that day without saying how, they are probably flying: tell them this.
- If it's been more than 2 years since your last dive, a refresher is normally required; very experienced divers (500+ dives, Dive Master) are reviewed by a member of our team. If you already did a refresher or a PADI ReActivate at another centre, it counts as your refresher and you can dive directly.
- For recreational dive outings, the refresher and the courses for already-certified divers (Advanced, Rescue, Divemaster and specialties), you must present your certified diver card. You can send us a photo of it beforehand or show it on the day of the activity.
- Muelle de la Bodeguita, 5 minutes from the historic center, at 8:00 AM. Departing from Cartagena there is no hotel pick-up: each person gets to the dock on their own (ground transportation to the dock is not included).
- By booking you accept our terms and conditions, cancellation policy, and data treatment. See: https://divingplanet.org/terminos-y-condiciones/
- Date changes are subject to availability and our terms and conditions. See: https://divingplanet.org/terminos-y-condiciones/
- Changes to the number of people on a booking you already made are subject to availability and our terms and conditions. See: https://divingplanet.org/terminos-y-condiciones/
- Colombians (anyone with Colombian nationality, holding a Colombian cédula or passport, wherever they live; also dual nationals when one nationality is Colombian) and residents of Colombia (holders of a cédula de extranjería, a resident ID; living in Colombia without one is not enough) pay in Colombian pesos (COP). Saying they are Colombian or from a Colombian city ("I'm from Cali") already says it; what is not enough is only having been born there while living abroad: then ask whether they hold Colombian nationality or a cédula de extranjería. All other international clients pay in US dollars (USD). A group does not pay in parts: if the same booking mixes Colombians or residents with international clients who hold no cédula de extranjería, the whole group pays in US dollars (USD), residents and Colombians included. A Colombian together with someone who holds a cédula de extranjería, wherever they are from, is not a mixed group: both pay in pesos (COP). The price is the same: only the currency changes (there is no discount for being Colombian).
- If the group mixes Colombians or residents with international clients who hold no cédula de extranjería, the whole group booking is paid in US dollars (USD), at the same equivalent price. Someone with a cédula de extranjería does not count as a foreigner, wherever they are from. There is no different price for being Colombian.
- If you are already on the Rosario Islands, we coordinate pick-up and drop-off from hotels with maritime access. In some cases the boat arrives directly at the hotel; in others we indicate the nearest dock or meeting point.
- These plans have different prices because they do not include transport from Cartagena or lunch.
- Pick-up is only on the Rosario Islands: Barú (including Playa Blanca, which is on Barú) is not part of the islands and we do not operate or pick up there; guests staying in Barú depart from Cartagena (Muelle de la Bodeguita).
- It depends on the activity: snorkeling from 6 years old; Bubble Makers from 8 to 10 years old (pool mini-course and very shallow water practice, max 2 meters); the dive mini-course and the Open Water course from 10 years old; the Advanced course and the Rescue course from 12. Minors must be accompanied by a demonstrable parent or responsible relative.
- The medical form is required for courses or mini-courses: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-curso-en-espanol (the form is in Spanish). The link can be sent together with the booking link; if you have not completed it, it is sent again in the booking confirmation email. Exception: the refresher (a review with an instructor) uses the course medical form, even if you are a certified diver.
- If you are a certified diver, there are no additional medical restrictions; your liability waiver is the certified-diver one: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-buzo-en-espanol (the form is in Spanish). For the refresher day this one is not used: use the course medical form.
- Bringing or drinking alcohol on the boat or during the activity is not allowed, and no alcohol or other substances may be consumed before diving. You must be in good physical condition.
- The booking system on our website. It automatically closes at 4:30 PM the day before: after that time you can no longer book for the next day, and you still book on the website for the next available day.
- To process the insurance, you must complete the form we send in the booking confirmation email.
- From Cartagena: departure at 8:00 a.m. from Muelle de la Bodeguita and return at 3:00 p.m. (arriving around 4:15 p.m.). From the islands: hotel pick-up between 9:30 and 9:45 a.m. (8:00 a.m. for specialties and 7:30 a.m. on day 2 of some courses). Daytime activities end around 12:00-1:00 p.m. (see the activity schedule). Night diving: in the evening (pick-up around 5:30 p.m., back around 7:30 p.m.). Online booking system closes at 4:30 p.m. the day before; after that, you book on the website for the next available day.
- We only close on December 25 and January 1. The rest of the year we operate every day, including public holidays, except for suspension due to adverse weather conditions.
- The tour includes water all day, coconut candy between dives, and lunch (rice with chicken or rice with vegetables). The menu is always the same, it does not change by day/supplier. Vegetarians, vegans, and celiacs receive rice with vegetables. Guests may bring their own food if needed (e.g. allergy or special diet). If the guest has a food allergy, they must inform us before the tour. In multi-day packages departing from Cartagena, lunch is included on the first day only; plans for guests already on the islands do not include lunch.
- Photos and videos are not offered proactively or included in the price. The instructor may take them voluntarily and delivers them by the next day at the latest. Any tip to the instructor for photos/videos is voluntary: each guest gives whatever they like, directly to them. This applies to every activity, including the mini-course (and the refresher, booked as a mini-course), PADI courses and certified-diver trips: not included, the instructor may take them voluntarily.
- The 3, 4, 5, 7 and 9 dive packages are exclusively for certified divers with a minimum Open Water level. They are not available for uncertified beginners.
- Two-day courses (Open Water, Referral Course, Advanced, Rescue and Mindful Diving) require accommodation on the islands: at least one night, the night of day 1 (there is no return to Cartagena on day 1). There is no option to commute from Cartagena on both days. Accommodation is not included and must be booked directly with the hotel. The same goes for multi-day dive packages (4, 5, 7 and 9 dives): you stay on the islands, and accommodation, which is not included, is booked directly with the hotel.
- Private services and closed groups are available, with no fixed price (it depends on the group and the date). A member of our team prepares the quote and coordinates an available instructor for the date.
- Through DIVE TO HEAL, more than 360 people with disabilities have been served. Accepted conditions include: hearing impairment (deaf), visual impairment (blind), reduced mobility (wheelchair), Down Syndrome, Cerebral Palsy, and Autism (depending on level and assessment). All instructors are trained in adaptive diving. Advance notice is recommended. The limitation is the presence of additional medical conditions that contraindicate diving.
- If you're already on the Rosario Islands and your hotel has maritime access, boat pick-up and drop-off are included at no extra charge.
- We dive in the Rosario Islands, inside the Corales del Rosario y San Bernardo National Natural Park, about 45-60 minutes by boat from Cartagena.
- All daytime activities (dive trips, mini-course, snorkeling, courses and each day of the packages) end around 12:00-1:00 p.m., followed by lunch. Guests departing from Cartagena have lunch included on the islands and the boat returns to Cartagena at 3:00 p.m. (arriving around 4:15 p.m.); guests staying on the islands return to their hotel around 12:00-1:00 p.m. for lunch (lunch not included). On overnight courses and packages, day 1's daytime activities also end around 12:00-1:00 p.m., and then you go to your hotel on the islands. Night diving (on plans that include it) is separate, in the evening (see each plan's schedule).
- There is always availability (confirmed by the business). We only close on December 25 and January 1, and a trip can be suspended due to adverse weather. The date and number of people are chosen in the booking link. To book for the next day, you need to do it before 4:30 p.m. (see booking system cutoff). Booking for the SAME day is no longer possible (trips leave in the morning and the website closes at 4:30 p.m. the day before): you book for the next available day.
- Each person can bring one backpack or bag on the boat. If the guest needs to bring a suitcase, it has to be arranged with a member of our team. If they prefer not to take it, we can store the suitcase at our office in Cartagena.
- What to bring: swimsuit, towel, sunscreen, sunglasses and comfortable clothes. Diving or snorkeling gear is included in dive trips, the mini-course, snorkeling and PADI courses; the Divemaster uses their own gear.
- At our base on the island there are lockers where you can leave your things (clothes, phone, wallet) while you dive or snorkel.
- There is no minimum number of people: every activity runs even for a single person.
- Activities and courses are taught in Spanish and English. If a participant speaks neither language, they can come with someone who interprets for them, but instruction is still given in Spanish or English.
- Bookings are made on our website, through each activity's link (with the 10% online discount). The system closes at 4:30 PM the day before: after that time you still book on the website, for the next available day.
- Besides the insurance form, each diver fills in a liability waiver. Our team sends it to you to complete (certified divers: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-buzo-en-espanol (the form is in Spanish)), and the confirmation email reminds you if you have not done it yet.
- The mini-course is a one-day try-dive, an introduction to diving: it does not certify, does not count as part of any PADI course and requires nothing from PADI beforehand (no PADI account or PADI online course). It is the same departing from Cartagena or already on the islands: there is no online or emailed theory; the theory is done there, on the day, along with pool practice and 1 ocean dive with an instructor.
- International clients pay 100% by card on the website; with a foreign card the passport is used as the ID document.
- Colombians and residents of Colombia (including holders of a cédula de extranjería) pay in pesos and do not use the website booking link: a team advisor always closes the booking in this chat and sends them the link, QR code or Llave to pay 100% online or a 50% deposit, and the other 50% on the day of the activity, by card or cash. The 50% deposit option is only for them. Nobody pays 100% at the dock without booking online.
- If you leave the next day around noon: from the Rosario Islands it is very tight (pickup is between 9:30 and 9:45 and the activity ends around 12:00-1:00 p.m.), so it is best to confirm it with a team advisor; departing from Cartagena it does not fit (the boat returns at 3:00 p.m. and arrives around 4:15 p.m.). To book for the next day you must do it before 4:30 p.m. the day before.
- Customers paying in US dollars book and pay through the online link: the payment is recorded right away and the team reconciles it shortly after to confirm the booking; only if the online payment fails does the team send a link to pay by transfer.
- If the booking system or the online payment fails, our team sends you a link to pay by bank transfer, and the 10% online discount is kept (because the online payment failed). Outside that case there is no payment by transfer: the 10% discount is for booking and paying online.

- Besides our base (Hotel San Pedro de Majagua and Hotel Cocoliso, on Isla Grande), other hotels in the area with maritime access are Rosario de Mar, Secreto, Ubuntu, Mulata, Eco Hotel Las Palmeras and Pao Pao. Accommodation is not included: it is booked directly with the hotel.

If they stay in a house, an Airbnb or a hotel not on our list, they tell us the name and an advisor confirms the pickup before they book and pay: they do not book until then.
- Returning to Cartagena on a different date from the plan is not included. If the guest wants to stay longer on the islands and come back with us another day, a member of our team arranges it (space on the boat, etc.).
- Departure and pickup times are fixed: they cannot be moved earlier or later. If you need an adjustment, a team advisor reviews it.
- Cancellations due to bad weather are unlikely because the Rosario Islands are in sheltered waters. If rescheduling is not possible, you get a 100% refund. See the terms and conditions: https://divingplanet.org/terminos-y-condiciones/
- Scuba diving is not possible during pregnancy: no mini-course, no dive trips and no courses (DAN and obstetricians advise against it for the whole pregnancy). Surface snorkeling is possible, with her doctor's approval. Whoever comes with her can dive as usual.
- If you get seasick on the boat (the ride to the islands is about 1 hour by speedboat): have a light breakfast before leaving and consider seasickness tablets. If you take any medication, ask your doctor whether you can dive with it.

- The boat is a regular speedboat with no bathroom. On the islands we use the facilities of the hotel where lunch is served: that is where you change, use the bathroom and shower.
- Diving Planet has no parking of its own; there are public car parks in the old town area, and the easiest way to reach the pier is by taxi.
- There is no gift card, but you can book in someone else's name; the date and details are arranged with an advisor.
- Smoking is not allowed on the boat.
- Pets are not allowed on the boat: we go to a National Natural Park.
- Babies and young children who are not yet old enough for any activity (snorkeling starts at 6) can ride the boat with their parents at any age, and they ride free.

msg: Buenas tardes. Mi esposa y yo venimos de Medellín a Cartagena de luna de miel y nos gustaría probar el buceo. Nunca lo hemos hecho y nos da un poquito de nervios. ¿Cuánto cuesta y qué incluye? Nos estamos quedando en Bocagrande.
reply:
¡Hola! 🪸 Soy *Coral*, de *Diving Planet* — buceamos todo el año en las Islas del Rosario, saliendo desde Cartagena o desde las propias islas. 🌊

¡Buenas tardes y felicidades por la luna de miel! 🐠 Qué bonito que quieran estrenarse buceando justo aquí, en las Islas del Rosario. Y tranqui con los nervios: es súper normal la primera vez, y para eso está el Minicurso de Buceo, que es justo la opción para quienes nunca han buceado. Van con instructor PADI en todo momento, empiezan con una sesión en piscina para coger confianza y luego hacen su primera inmersión en el arrecife. Se van a enamorar. 💙

Te cuento cómo es el día y qué incluye:

**Minicurso de Buceo (desde Cartagena, 1 día)**
- Punto de encuentro: Muelle de la Bodeguita, a las 8:00 a.m. (a 5 min del centro histórico). Ojo: desde Cartagena no hay recogida en el hotel, cada uno llega por su cuenta al muelle.
- Lancha rápida a las Islas del Rosario (aprox. 1 hora).
- Sesión en piscina: teoría y práctica en aguas confinadas.
- 1 inmersión en mar con instructor PADI + intervalo de superficie.
- Regreso a Cartagena a las 3:00 p.m. (llegada estimada 4:15 p.m.).

**Incluye:** tarifa de ingreso al Parque Nacional Natural, seguro obligatorio de buceo, transporte en lancha Cartagena–Islas–Cartagena, entrenamiento en piscina + 1 inmersión en mar con instructor PADI, equipo de buceo completo, almuerzo y aporte eco-social a DIVE TO HEAL.

**No incluye:** transporte terrestre al muelle, fotos o videos submarinos, propinas voluntarias, comida adicional al almuerzo y regreso en una fecha distinta a la programada.

Como son colombianos, el pago va en pesos y lo coordina un asesor al cerrar la reserva (100% online, o 50% de anticipo y el resto el día de la actividad).

Te dejo los precios por persona a continuación 👇

*Precios por persona* (online · normal):
• Minicurso de Buceo: 655.000 COP · 727.000 COP
• Tour de Snorkeling: 448.000 COP · 497.000 COP

Para una primera vez te recomiendo el *minicurso*: teoría, práctica en aguas tranquilas y una inmersión en el mar con instructor, sin necesidad de experiencia. Si lo que buscas es certificarte, está el *curso PADI Open Water*. ¿Te animas con el minicurso? 🤿

msg: Gracias. Nos interesa el minicurso, para los dos. ¿A qué profundidad se baja? Y mi esposa pregunta si hace falta saber nadar muy bien, porque ella nada lo justo. Quisiéramos ir el sábado 14 de noviembre.
reply:
El minicurso baja hasta **12 metros**; lo habitual es estar entre 5 y 12 metros. La profundidad exacta depende del punto de buceo y siempre se respeta ese límite.

Sobre saber nadar: no tengo ese requisito confirmado para el minicurso. Como tu esposa tiene poca confianza en el agua, es importante que lo revise con el equipo antes de reservar; no puedo asegurarle por aquí que sea adecuado para ella.

También necesitas:
• No hay teoría que hacer antes: se hace allí, el mismo día, con el instructor.

msg: Perfecto, gracias, espero entonces lo del asma. Mientras tanto, otra duda: tengo que estar en Bogotá el lunes para trabajar. Si hago el curso sábado y domingo, ¿puedo coger un vuelo el domingo por la noche, cuando vuelva a Cartagena? Y sobre la teoría, ¿tengo que estudiar algo antes de ir?
reply:
Para el Curso Open Water, la teoría se hace antes en PADI eLearning y debes completarla para empezar la práctica; toma aproximadamente 10 a 12 horas.

Sobre el vuelo: después de bucear debes esperar al menos 18 horas antes de volar. El domingo el curso termina con las inmersiones y el regreso a Cartagena es alrededor de las 3:00 p. m., así que un vuelo esa misma noche no cumple ese intervalo. El asesor ya tiene tu consulta sobre el asma y te escribirá por aquí.

También necesitas:
• Con este plan debes alojarte al menos 1 noche en las Islas del Rosario (hotel no incluido)
• Para cursos o minicursos se requiere el formulario médico: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-curso-en-espanol. El enlace se puede enviar junto con el de la reserva; si no lo has completado, te llega otra vez en el correo de confirmación de la reserva. Excepción: el refresher (repaso con instructor) usa el formulario médico de curso, aunque seas buzo certificado.
• Para procesar el seguro, debes completar el formato que te enviamos en el correo de confirmación.
• Edad mínima: desde los 10 años.
• Qué llevar: bañador, toalla, crema de sol, gafas de sol y ropa cómoda. El equipo de buceo o de snorkel va incluido en las salidas de buceo, el minicurso, el snorkel y los cursos PADI; en el Divemaster se usa equipo propio.

Para preguntas médicas específicas, es importante que hables con nuestro staff calificado para evaluar tu situación particular. Te paso ahora con alguien del equipo, que te escribe por aquí enseguida.

msg: Hey! Planning a bachelor party in Cartagena in February, there will be 6 of us from Texas. Three of the guys are certified and three have never dived. We want one day out on the water together. What's the deal price-wise for a group like ours? And can we pay with US credit cards? One of us would pay for everybody.
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

That sounds like a great day out on the water! Since you’re all coming from Texas, prices are in USD.

For the three certified divers, the Cartagena one-day option is **Fun Dives — 2 dives**. The three who haven’t dived before can choose a **Dive Mini Course**, **snorkeling**, or to come along as companions. The mini-course is an introductory experience, not a certification, so it doesn’t include certified dives.

I’m leaving the per-person prices below. Your group qualifies for the **10% group discount**, which must be requested before paying; it can combine with the online discount. The certified-diving booking link is [here](https://book.divingplanet.org/book/salidas-de-buceo/1?language=en), and the separate mini-course link is [here](https://book.divingplanet.org/book/minicurso-de-buceo/2?language=en). Snorkeling and companion options can also be included in the group plan.

Yes, international guests can pay by credit card on the website, and one person can pay for the booking. Payment is made in full by card; with a foreign card, the passport is used as the ID document.

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day): 178 USD · 197 USD
• Dive Mini Course: 183 USD · 204 USD

Would you like to continue with the booking options for all six?

msg: Good call on asking: one of the certified guys, Mike, last dived about three years ago. The other two dived last summer. No beers, got it. So what does Mike need to do? And who do I talk to on your team to get the group discount before we pay?
reply:
Since Mike last dived about three years ago, a refresher is normally required. It’s a short in-water review with an instructor, done on the day; there’s no theory to complete beforehand. If he has already completed a refresher or PADI ReActivate at another center, that counts. He should bring his certification card, and the refresher uses the course medical form: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-curso-en-espanol

To get the group discount, contact the team and request it **before paying**. The 10% group discount applies to your recreational dives and mini-courses and stacks with the 10% online discount. It won’t be added automatically, and it can’t be applied after payment. Would you like me to connect you with a team advisor?

You'll also need:
• To process the insurance, you must complete the form we send in the booking confirmation email.
• After diving, wait at least 18 hours before flying
• Minimum age: 10 and over.
• What to bring: swimsuit, towel, sunscreen, sunglasses and comfortable clothes. Diving or snorkeling gear is included in dive trips, the mini-course, snorkeling and PADI courses; the Divemaster uses their own gear.
• After diving, wait at least 12 hours before flying

Keep in mind that the mini-course is a one-day introduction and does not certify you; to get certified there is the Open Water course (2 days, with a night on the islands).

msg: Good afternoon. My name is Anna, I am from Germany. I will stay at the Hotel San Pedro de Majagua on Isla Grande from November 20 to 24. I am a PADI Advanced diver with about 80 dives, my last dive was in September in Egypt. How does it work when I am already on the island: do you pick me up at the hotel, and what does it cost? I would like to dive on two of the days.
reply:
Hi, Anna! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

Good afternoon, Anna! Diving from Isla Grande is a lovely way to explore the Rosario Islands’ reefs. Yes, San Pedro de Majagua is one of our base hotels, so pick-up and return by boat are included at no extra charge. For daytime dives, pick-up is around 9:30–9:45 a.m., and you’ll return around 12:00–1:00 p.m.; lunch isn’t included for island-based plans.

For two days of diving, the two-day options include four daytime dives, or five dives with a night dive. I’m leaving the prices below.

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• 4-dive package (2 days, 4 daytime dives): 204 USD · 227 USD
• Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day): 124 USD · 138 USD
• 4-dive package (2 days, 3 daytime + 1 night dive): 236 USD · 262 USD
• 5-dive package (2 days): 319 USD · 354 USD

From the islands we coordinate pick-up and drop-off at your hotel if it has maritime access, or at the nearest dock we point you to.

Would you prefer daytime dives only, or would you like to include a night dive?

The 4 daytime dives on November 22 and 23 would finish around 12:00–1:00 p.m. on November 23. You’ll have more than 18 hours before your flight on November 24 at 4:00 p.m., so that timing meets the minimum post-dive wait.

For the boat back to Cartagena on November 24, returning on a different day from the package isn’t included. A team advisor would need to arrange the boat space and confirm the details. I don’t have information about suitcase transport, so that would also need to be confirmed with the advisor.

How many people would this be for: just you, or more? 😊

Diving Planet policies:
- Wait at least 18 hours to take a flight after recreational diving. 12 hours minimum after the mini course (only for non-certified divers). The refresher is also 18 hours: it is for certified divers, even though it is booked as the mini course. The hours count from the last dive, not from the return to Cartagena. The mini course dive ends around 12:00 (noon): its 12 hours count from then. If the last dive is a daytime one, the refresher's included (activities end around 12:00-1:00 p.m.), you can fly from 7:00 a.m. the next day; after the mini-course, from midnight that same day. If the last dive is a night dive, the hours count from it. A flight the next day at 7:00 a.m. or later IS fine: they can dive the day before, and that day's return time to Cartagena changes nothing. For a certified diver, a flight on the SAME day as the dive NEVER works, whatever the time, even at night: with a flight on Sunday night, the last dive must be on Saturday at the latest; the boat being back before they leave does not fix it. If they say they leave that day without saying how, they are probably flying: tell them this.
- If it's been more than 2 years since your last dive, a refresher is normally required; very experienced divers (500+ dives, Dive Master) are reviewed by a member of our team. If you already did a refresher or a PADI ReActivate at another centre, it counts as your refresher and you can dive directly.
- For recreational dive outings, the refresher and the courses for already-certified divers (Advanced, Rescue, Divemaster and specialties), you must present your certified diver card. You can send us a photo of it beforehand or show it on the day of the activity.
- Muelle de la Bodeguita, 5 minutes from the historic center, at 8:00 AM. Departing from Cartagena there is no hotel pick-up: each person gets to the dock on their own (ground transportation to the dock is not included).
- By booking you accept our terms and conditions, cancellation policy, and data treatment. See: https://divingplanet.org/terminos-y-condiciones/
- Date changes are subject to availability and our terms and conditions. See: https://divingplanet.org/terminos-y-condiciones/
- Changes to the number of people on a booking you already made are subject to availability and our terms and conditions. See: https://divingplanet.org/terminos-y-condiciones/
- Colombians (anyone with Colombian nationality, holding a Colombian cédula or passport, wherever they live; also dual nationals when one nationality is Colombian) and residents of Colombia (holders of a cédula de extranjería, a resident ID; living in Colombia without one is not enough) pay in Colombian pesos (COP). Saying they are Colombian or from a Colombian city ("I'm from Cali") already says it; what is not enough is only having been born there while living abroad: then ask whether they hold Colombian nationality or a cédula de extranjería. All other international clients pay in US dollars (USD). A group does not pay in parts: if the same booking mixes Colombians or residents with international clients who hold no cédula de extranjería, the whole group pays in US dollars (USD), residents and Colombians included. A Colombian together with someone who holds a cédula de extranjería, wherever they are from, is not a mixed group: both pay in pesos (COP). The price is the same: only the currency changes (there is no discount for being Colombian).
- If the group mixes Colombians or residents with international clients who hold no cédula de extranjería, the whole group booking is paid in US dollars (USD), at the same equivalent price. Someone with a cédula de extranjería does not count as a foreigner, wherever they are from. There is no different price for being Colombian.
- If you are already on the Rosario Islands, we coordinate pick-up and drop-off from hotels with maritime access. In some cases the boat arrives directly at the hotel; in others we indicate the nearest dock or meeting point.
- These plans have different prices because they do not include transport from Cartagena or lunch.
- Pick-up is only on the Rosario Islands: Barú (including Playa Blanca, which is on Barú) is not part of the islands and we do not operate or pick up there; guests staying in Barú depart from Cartagena (Muelle de la Bodeguita).
- It depends on the activity: snorkeling from 6 years old; Bubble Makers from 8 to 10 years old (pool mini-course and very shallow water practice, max 2 meters); the dive mini-course and the Open Water course from 10 years old; the Advanced course and the Rescue course from 12. Minors must be accompanied by a demonstrable parent or responsible relative.
- The medical form is required for courses or mini-courses: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-curso-en-espanol (the form is in Spanish). The link can be sent together with the booking link; if you have not completed it, it is sent again in the booking confirmation email. Exception: the refresher (a review with an instructor) uses the course medical form, even if you are a certified diver.
- If you are a certified diver, there are no additional medical restrictions; your liability waiver is the certified-diver one: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-buzo-en-espanol (the form is in Spanish). For the refresher day this one is not used: use the course medical form.
- Bringing or drinking alcohol on the boat or during the activity is not allowed, and no alcohol or other substances may be consumed before diving. You must be in good physical condition.
- The booking system on our website. It automatically closes at 4:30 PM the day before: after that time you can no longer book for the next day, and you still book on the website for the next available day.
- To process the insurance, you must complete the form we send in the booking confirmation email.
- From Cartagena: departure at 8:00 a.m. from Muelle de la Bodeguita and return at 3:00 p.m. (arriving around 4:15 p.m.). Daytime activities end around 12:00-1:00 p.m. (see the activity schedule). Night diving: in the evening (pick-up around 5:30 p.m., back around 7:30 p.m.). Online booking system closes at 4:30 p.m. the day before; after that, you book on the website for the next available day.
- We only close on December 25 and January 1. The rest of the year we operate every day, including public holidays, except for suspension due to adverse weather conditions.

If the guest has a food allergy, they must inform us before the tour. In multi-day packages departing from Cartagena, lunch is included on the first day only; plans for guests already on the islands do not include lunch.

- The 3, 4, 5, 7 and 9 dive packages are exclusively for certified divers with a minimum Open Water level. They are not available for uncertified beginners.

There is no option to commute from Cartagena on both days. Accommodation is not included and must be booked directly with the hotel. The same goes for multi-day dive packages (4, 5, 7 and 9 dives): you stay on the islands, and accommodation, which is not included, is booked directly with the hotel.
- Private services and closed groups are available, with no fixed price (it depends on the group and the date). A member of our team prepares the quote and coordinates an available instructor for the date.
- Through DIVE TO HEAL, more than 360 people with disabilities have been served. Accepted conditions include: hearing impairment (deaf), visual impairment (blind), reduced mobility (wheelchair), Down Syndrome, Cerebral Palsy, and Autism (depending on level and assessment). All instructors are trained in adaptive diving. Advance notice is recommended. The limitation is the presence of additional medical conditions that contraindicate diving.
- If you're already on the Rosario Islands and your hotel has maritime access, boat pick-up and drop-off are included at no extra charge.
- We dive in the Rosario Islands, inside the Corales del Rosario y San Bernardo National Natural Park, about 45-60 minutes by boat from Cartagena.
- All daytime activities (dive trips, mini-course, snorkeling, courses and each day of the packages) end around 12:00-1:00 p.m., followed by lunch. Guests departing from Cartagena have lunch included on the islands and the boat returns to Cartagena at 3:00 p.m. (arriving around 4:15 p.m.); guests staying on the islands return to their hotel around 12:00-1:00 p.m. for lunch (lunch not included). - There is always availability (confirmed by the business). We only close on December 25 and January 1, and a trip can be suspended due to adverse weather. - Each person can bring one backpack or bag on the boat. If the guest needs to bring a suitcase, it has to be arranged with a member of our team. If they prefer not to take it, we can store the suitcase at our office in Cartagena.
- What to bring: swimsuit, towel, sunscreen, sunglasses and comfortable clothes. Diving or snorkeling gear is included in dive trips, the mini-course, snorkeling and PADI courses; the Divemaster uses their own gear.
- At our base on the island there are lockers where you can leave your things (clothes, phone, wallet) while you dive or snorkel.
- There is no minimum number of people: every activity runs even for a single person.
- Activities and courses are taught in Spanish and English. If a participant speaks neither language, they can come with someone who interprets for them, but instruction is still given in Spanish or English.
- Bookings are made on our website, through each activity's link (with the 10% online discount). The system closes at 4:30 PM the day before: after that time you still book on the website, for the next available day.
- Besides the insurance form, each diver fills in a liability waiver. Our team sends it to you to complete (certified divers: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-buzo-en-espanol (the form is in Spanish)), and the confirmation email reminds you if you have not done it yet.
- The mini-course is a one-day try-dive, an introduction to diving: it does not certify, does not count as part of any PADI course and requires nothing from PADI beforehand (no PADI account or PADI online course). It is the same departing from Cartagena or already on the islands: there is no online or emailed theory; the theory is done there, on the day, along with pool practice and 1 ocean dive with an instructor.
- International clients pay 100% by card on the website; with a foreign card the passport is used as the ID document.
- Colombians and residents of Colombia (including holders of a cédula de extranjería) pay in pesos and do not use the website booking link: a team advisor always closes the booking in this chat and sends them the link, QR code or Llave to pay 100% online or a 50% deposit, and the other 50% on the day of the activity, by card or cash. The 50% deposit option is only for them. Nobody pays 100% at the dock without booking online.
- If you leave the next day around noon: from the Rosario Islands it is very tight (pickup is between 9:30 and 9:45 and the activity ends around 12:00-1:00 p.m.), so it is best to confirm it with a team advisor; departing from Cartagena it does not fit (the boat returns at 3:00 p.m. and arrives around 4:15 p.m.). To book for the next day you must do it before 4:30 p.m. the day before.
- Customers paying in US dollars book and pay through the online link: the payment is recorded right away and the team reconciles it shortly after to confirm the booking; only if the online payment fails does the team send a link to pay by transfer.
- If the booking system or the online payment fails, our team sends you a link to pay by bank transfer, and the 10% online discount is kept (because the online payment failed). Outside that case there is no payment by transfer: the 10% discount is for booking and paying online.
- In groups combining diving and snorkeling, snorkeling takes place in a different area from the dive sites. If there are few people everyone goes on the same boat; otherwise the group is split by activity.
- Besides our base (Hotel San Pedro de Majagua and Hotel Cocoliso, on Isla Grande), other hotels in the area with maritime access are Rosario de Mar, Secreto, Ubuntu, Mulata, Eco Hotel Las Palmeras and Pao Pao. Accommodation is not included: it is booked directly with the hotel.
- To book an activity departing from the islands, the customer must already have their hotel and tell us which one: pickup is arranged there. If they don't have it yet, they first book the hotel and message us with its name; then we book. If they booked the activity first, the hotel could be cancelled, it could be full, they could forget to tell us or end up departing from Cartagena. If they stay in a house, an Airbnb or a hotel not on our list, they tell us the name and an advisor confirms the pickup before they book and pay: they do not book until then.
- Returning to Cartagena on a different date from the plan is not included. If the guest wants to stay longer on the islands and come back with us another day, a member of our team arranges it (space on the boat, etc.).
- Departure and pickup times are fixed: they cannot be moved earlier or later. If you need an adjustment, a team advisor reviews it.
- Cancellations due to bad weather are unlikely because the Rosario Islands are in sheltered waters. If the Port Authority (Capitanía de Puerto) closes departures to the islands, we first try to reschedule the activity so you don't lose your booking. If rescheduling is not possible, you get a 100% refund. See the terms and conditions: https://divingplanet.org/terminos-y-condiciones/
- Scuba diving is not possible during pregnancy: no mini-course, no dive trips and no courses (DAN and obstetricians advise against it for the whole pregnancy). Surface snorkeling is possible, with her doctor's approval. Whoever comes with her can dive as usual.
- If you get seasick on the boat (the ride to the islands is about 1 hour by speedboat): have a light breakfast before leaving and consider seasickness tablets. If you take any medication, ask your doctor whether you can dive with it.
- We do issue invoices (also to companies). An advisor from our team coordinates the invoice details with the customer.
- There is no maximum age for diving: an older person can dive with the same medical form as everyone else.
- We carry oxygen and a first-aid kit on board, with trained staff, and there is an emergency protocol.
- Groups are small and follow PADI safety standards for each activity.
- The boat is a regular speedboat with no bathroom. On the islands we use the facilities of the hotel where lunch is served: that is where you change, use the bathroom and shower.
- Diving Planet has no parking of its own; there are public car parks in the old town area, and the easiest way to reach the pier is by taxi.
- There is no gift card, but you can book in someone else's name; the date and details are arranged with an advisor.
- Smoking is not allowed on the boat.
- Pets are not allowed on the boat: we go to a National Natural Park.
- Babies and young children who are not yet old enough for any activity (snorkeling starts at 6) can ride the boat with their parents at any age, and they ride free.
- You can bring your own camera on the dives or snorkeling, at your own risk. Diving Planet does not rent cameras.

Question: Is diving safe?
Other ways to ask: Is it safe to go diving? / Are there risks in diving or is it considered safe?
Answer: Yes, diving is safe when procedures and training limits are followed. The basic rules are: never hold your breath, ascend slowly, always dive with a buddy, equalize early and often, respect depth limits, constantly monitor your air, and follow the instructor or guide. The bot can give general guidance, but it cannot clear someone medically or replace a dive professional's judgment.

[10] Fuente: faqs
Question: Are fish, sharks, starfish, coral, or sea urchins dangerous?
Other ways to ask: Is it dangerous to encounter sharks, fish, or sea urchins while diving? / Should I be concerned about marine animals like coral or starfish when diving?
Answer: Most fish avoid humans. If you see a shark, the recommended approach is to stay calm, observe, and enjoy the moment from a respectful distance; encounters are usually safe. Touching starfish, turtles, coral, or any organism is not recommended: many are delicate or sensitive. Many minor diving injuries occur from accidental contact with coral or sea urchins, which is why neutral buoyancy and not touching anything are fundamental for safety.

reply:
¡Hola! 🪸 Soy *Coral*, de *Diving Planet* — buceamos todo el año en las Islas del Rosario, saliendo desde Cartagena o desde las propias islas. 🌊

Ernesto. ¡Qué chévere que vengan a conocer las Islas del Rosario! Sí, tu esposa puede acompañarte en la lancha con el plan de acompañante. Saliendo desde Cartagena incluye el transporte en lancha, almuerzo, seguro y entrada al Parque Nacional Natural; cuesta **80 USD online** o **89 USD precio normal**. No incluye equipo de snorkel y el plan es para quien no bucea ni hace snorkel.

También puede quedarse en nuestra base en la isla mientras tú buceas. Como llevas unos cinco años sin bucear, el repaso para buzos certificados se reserva como **Minicurso de Buceo**; te recomiendo consultar esa opción antes de elegir la salida recreativa.

Si llevas más de 2 años sin bucear, normalmente hace falta un refresh antes de la salida; si ya hiciste un refresh o un PADI ReActivate en otro centro, cuenta como tu refresh.

Sí, tu esposa puede hacer snorkel mientras tú buceas. El snorkel es desde los 6 años y no requiere certificación; saber nadar bien es recomendable para sentirse cómoda en el agua. También puede elegir entre hacer un minicurso de buceo, snorkel o ir de acompañante.

Sobre tu hipertensión y el medicamento, eso debe revisarlo una persona del equipo; no puedo determinar si puedes bucear. En cuanto a la edad, no hay edad máxima para bucear.

Para preguntas médicas específicas, es importante que hables con nuestro staff calificado para evaluar tu situación particular. Te paso ahora con alguien del equipo, que te escribe por aquí enseguida.

msg: Hiya! I'm Priya, a British backpacker on a tight budget, currently in Santa Marta and heading to Cartagena next week. I've got three free days, November 17 to 19, and I've always wanted to get my diving certification. Is that doable in three days, and what's the cheapest way of doing it? I've got a hostel in Getsemaní booked already.
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

That’s a lovely goal, Priya! Yes, you can complete the PADI Open Water course within your three free days: the course itself takes two days, with online theory beforehand. You’ll need to stay overnight on the Rosario Islands after day one; your Getsemaní hostel won’t cover that, as there’s no return to Cartagena that evening. Accommodation on the islands isn’t included and must be booked directly with a hotel.

The lowest-cost certification option is the PADI Open Water course. I’m leaving its price below. From Cartagena, you meet at Muelle de la Bodeguita at 8:00 a.m.; the boat returns on day two at 3:00 p.m., arriving around 4:15 p.m.

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• PADI Basic Course (Open Water): 693 USD · 770 USD

Would you like to continue with the booking for November 17–19?

msg: Brilliant. How long does the online theory take, and when do I get access to it? I'd have about a week to do it. Also, I need somewhere cheap to sleep on the island for that one night: do you know a budget option? And would I save anything by going to the island the day before and starting from there?
reply:
The Open Water eLearning takes about **10–12 hours** and must be completed before the practical sessions. You’ll have about a week, which should give you time to work through it. The course details say access is provided with enrollment; they don’t specify exactly when it arrives.

I don’t have hotel prices or a specific budget recommendation. Accommodation isn’t included and is booked directly with the hotel. Options with maritime access include Rosario de Mar, Secreto, Ubuntu, Mulata, Eco Hotel Las Palmeras, and Pao Pao, as well as our base hotels, San Pedro de Majagua and Cocoliso.

The listed Open Water course is for two days and includes the Cartagena–islands–Cartagena boat transfer. I don’t have a separate price for starting from the islands, so I can’t confirm whether going there the day before would save money.

How many people would this be for: just you, or more? 😊

msg: Just me. Okay, I'll start from Cartagena then. What should I bring with me for the two days? I only have my big backpack, can I take it on the boat or leave it somewhere? I'd also love to bring my GoPro. And can I pay in cash when I arrive? My UK card charges me a fee abroad.
reply:
For the two days, bring your swimsuit, towel, sunscreen, sunglasses and comfortable clothes. Diving equipment is included. Your course includes lunch on day one; extra food and your island accommodation aren’t included.

You can bring one backpack or bag on the boat, so your big backpack is fine. If you’d rather not take it, you can leave it at our Cartagena office. There are lockers at our island base for smaller belongings while you’re diving.

You’re welcome to bring your GoPro, but underwater photos and videos aren’t included in the course.

You'll also need:
• With this plan you must stay at least 1 night on the Rosario Islands (hotel not included)
• The theory is done through PADI eLearning (approx. 10 to 12 hours). You must complete it before starting the practical phase.
• The medical form is required for courses or mini-courses: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-curso-en-espanol (the form is in Spanish). The link can be sent together with the booking link; if you have not completed it, it is sent again in the booking confirmation email. Exception: the refresher (a review with an instructor) uses the course medical form, even if you are a certified diver.
• To process the insurance, you must complete the form we send in the booking confirmation email.
• After diving, wait at least 18 hours before flying
• Minimum age: 10 and over.

Since you’re an international guest, payment is 100% by card through the website; cash payment on arrival isn’t available. I understand the foreign-card fee is frustrating. Would you like to continue with the online booking?

🤿 *PADI Basic Course (Open Water)*
💰 *693 USD* per person (online rate)
📚 PADI course: dates, sessions and details are arranged with you.

👉 *For more information and to book, click here:*
https://book.divingplanet.org/book/basic-course/4?language=en

Guests who are not Colombian or residents of Colombia pay in US dollars (USD) by card on the website; the rate is the same, only the currency changes.

msg: Okay, thanks. So who can tell me about the GoPro? I'd really like to film my first dives, it's kind of the whole point for me. And is storing my backpack at your office free? Last thing: I've got a flight to Medellín on the 19th at 9 in the morning, is that fine if I finish the course on the 18th?
reply:
You can bring your GoPro on the dives at your own risk. We don’t rent cameras, and filming isn’t included in the course. An instructor may take photos or videos as a voluntary gesture, but it isn’t guaranteed; if they do, they’ll share them by the next day at the latest. Any tip is optional and given directly to the instructor.

You can leave your backpack at our Cartagena office, but I don’t have the storage fee information handy. You can also bring one backpack or bag on the boat.

Your 9:00 a.m. flight on the 19th is **not fine** after finishing the Open Water course on the 18th. The course requires at least 18 hours between your last dive and flying, and the final dives are on day two. Please check the timing with a team advisor before booking, as your flight may mean you need to change your plans. Would you like me to connect you with one?

También incluye:
• 2 inmersiones guiadas con un profesional PADI certificado

msg: Hi! We're two certified divers visiting Cartagena next week from Chicago. Do you run dive trips to the Rosario Islands?

Yes—we run guided dive trips to the Rosario Islands, about an hour by boat from Cartagena. It’s a beautiful Caribbean reef experience 🐠

For certified divers, our one-day trip includes two guided reef dives, equipment, boat transport, and lunch. It departs at 8:00 a.m. from Muelle de la Bodeguita and returns to Cartagena at approximately 4:15 p.m.

You’ll need to bring your certification card. If it’s been more than two years since your last dive, a refresher is normally required.

*From Cartagena* — boat from Muelle de la Bodeguita · lunch included
• Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day): 178 USD · 197 USD
*Already on the Rosario Islands* — pickup at your hotel if it has boat access · no lunch
• Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day): 124 USD · 138 USD

So, would you leave *from Cartagena* (Muelle de la Bodeguita)? 🚤

msg: Our flight home leaves at 7:00 AM the day after we dive. Is that okay?
reply:
Yes—**a 7:00 a.m. flight the day after a daytime dive is okay**. As certified divers, you need to wait at least 18 hours after your last dive; the daytime dives end around 12:00–1:00 p.m., and the wait is counted from the last dive, not from your return to Cartagena. 🪸

This applies to the two-dive daytime trip. If you choose a plan with a night dive, the waiting period starts after that night dive.

So, would you leave *from Cartagena* (Muelle de la Bodeguita)? 🚤

msg: Queremos hacer las 2 inmersiones en un día. ¿Cómo reservamos todos juntos y cuándo hay que pedir el descuento?
reply:
¡Qué buen plan! Las dos inmersiones desde Cartagena son en puntos distintos y el plan incluye la lancha de ida y vuelta y el almuerzo.

Para reservar los seis juntos, elige seis personas en el calendario de este enlace: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/salidas-de-buceo/1?language=es

Antes de pagar, deben pedir al equipo que aplique el descuento de grupo del 10%. Se suma al 10% online, para un 20% total al reservar por la web. No se aplica automáticamente y, si pagan antes de solicitarlo, ya no se puede aplicar después. Como la reserva es mixta, el pago se hace en USD.

Si sales desde las islas, antes necesito saber tu hotel. ¿Saldrías *desde Cartagena* o ya estás *en las Islas del Rosario*? 🌊

msg: Hi, I'm a German traveler in Cartagena and I've never dived. I'd like to get my Open Water certification. How long does the course take?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

The PADI Open Water course takes **2 days**. It’s a great way to start diving, and no prior certification is needed.

From Cartagena, you meet at **Muelle de la Bodeguita at 8:00 a.m. on Day 1**. The course includes online theory before the trip, pool sessions, and four certification dives across the two days. You’ll need to stay overnight on the islands after Day 1; accommodation isn’t included. The return to Cartagena on Day 2 is at **3:00 p.m.**, arriving around **4:15 p.m.**

The online price is **USD 693 per person** (regular price: **USD 770**). Would you like to continue with the booking?

msg: ¿Ella puede hacer algo en el agua? ¿Y necesitaría algún permiso médico?
reply:
Sí, puede hacer snorkel en superficie con el visto bueno de su médico. Durante el embarazo no se recomienda bucear con botella.

No tengo información de un permiso médico específico para hacer snorkel; la indicación es contar con el visto bueno de su médico. Para ti, como buzo certificado, debes presentar tu carné de buzo certificado. 🐠

También necesitas:
• Para procesar el seguro, debes completar el formato que te enviamos en el correo de confirmación.
• Para cursos o minicursos se requiere el formulario médico: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-curso-en-espanol. El enlace se puede enviar junto con el de la reserva; si no lo has completado, te llega otra vez en el correo de confirmación de la reserva. Excepción: el refresher (repaso con instructor) usa el formulario médico de curso, aunque seas buzo certificado.
• Qué llevar: bañador, toalla, crema de sol, gafas de sol y ropa cómoda. El equipo de buceo o de snorkel va incluido en las salidas de buceo, el minicurso, el snorkel y los cursos PADI; en el Divemaster se usa equipo propio.
• Si llevas más de 2 años sin bucear, normalmente se requiere un refresh; los buzos muy experimentados (500+ inmersiones, Dive Master) los revisa un asesor del equipo. Si ya hiciste un refresh o un PADI ReActivate en otro centro, cuenta como tu refresh y puedes bucear directamente.

• 7 Dives - 3 days: 503 USD · 558 USD
• 9 Dives - 4 days: 602 USD · 668 USD
*Already on the Rosario Islands* — pickup at your hotel if it has boat access · no lunch
• 4-dive package (2 days, 4 daytime dives): 204 USD · 227 USD
• 7-dive package (3 days): 432 USD · 480 USD
• 9-dive package (4 days): 544 USD · 605 USD

So, would you leave *from Cartagena* (Muelle de la Bodeguita)? 🚤

msg: Do I need a refresher since it's been so long? And how do I book?
reply:
Since it’s been more than two years since your last dive, a refresher is normally required. With about 30 dives, you don’t meet the 500+ dives threshold for a team review. If you’ve already completed a refresher or PADI ReActivate at another centre, that counts.

You can book the refresher online here: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/minicurso-de-buceo/2?language=en. It’s listed as the Dive Mini Course, and the 10% online discount is applied automatically. The refresher includes pool practice and one reef dive with a PADI instructor. There’s no theory to do beforehand. Please bring your certified diver card; the refresher uses the course medical form, and you’ll also need to complete the insurance form sent with your booking confirmation. After diving, wait at least 18 hours before flying.

Guests who are not Colombian or residents of Colombia pay in US dollars (USD) by card on the website; the rate is the same, only the currency changes.

How many people would this be for: just you, or more? 😊

msg: ¿Nos recogen en Barú? ¿Dónde y a qué hora tendríamos que estar?
reply:
No, en Barú no hacemos recogidas; está fuera de las Islas del Rosario. Como se alojan allí, tendrían que llegar por su cuenta al *Muelle de la Bodeguita* en Cartagena, a las *8:00 a. m.*. No hay recogida en hoteles de Cartagena y el transporte terrestre hasta el muelle no está incluido.

El muelle queda a unos 5 minutos del centro histórico. Al llegar, pregunten por *Diving Planet* en la entrada 3. La lancha regresa a Cartagena a las 3:00 p. m.; la llegada estimada es a las 4:15 p. m.

¿Saldrías *desde Cartagena* o ya estás *en las Islas del Rosario*? Así te paso el plan exacto. 🌊

msg: Great, thanks. So the plan would be: my husband diving, our 11-year-old trying scuba for the first time, and me and our 6-year-old snorkeling, all on December 3 from Hotel Cocoliso. We're US citizens. How do we book and pay?
reply:
That plan works well for your family: your husband can book certified diving, your 11-year-old can try the Dive Mini Course, and you and your 6-year-old can snorkel. The mini-course is a separate activity from certified diving.

You’ll need to make three separate online bookings for December 3:
- **Certified diving:** the team handles this booking. Would you like me to connect you with a team advisor for the booking link?
- **Dive Mini Course:** https://book.divingplanet.org/book/dive-mini-course-already-on-island/20?language=en
- **Snorkeling:** https://book.divingplanet.org/book/snorkeling-already-on-the-island/25?language=en

As US citizens, you pay in USD by card on the website. The 10% online discount is applied automatically. Payment is recorded right away, then the team reconciles it shortly after to confirm the booking. If the online payment fails, the team can provide a bank-transfer link.

There is always availability: we operate every day, including public holidays, except December 25 and January 1; if sea conditions are not safe, the trip is rescheduled.

For the one who hasn't chosen yet I'd recommend these options. Which one do they like best? 🐠
• *Dive mini-course* — A first time underwater with an instructor: pool training and a real dive. No experience needed.
• *Open Water course* — Entry certification course: qualifies you to dive independently down to 18 m.
• *Snorkeling* — Enjoy the reef from the surface, with mask and fins. Great for families.
• *Come along as a companion* — Comes on the boat and enjoys the day with the group, without getting in the water.

La hora de regreso de la lancha a Cartagena no cambia ese cálculo.

El paquete que mencionaste incluye cuatro inmersiones diurnas, sin nocturna.

msg: ¿Cómo es el curso Open Water con ustedes? ¿Cuántos días dura, hay que estudiar algo antes y se puede ir y volver a Cartagena cada día?
reply:
¡Es una experiencia buenísima para empezar a bucear! El Open Water dura **2 días** y te certifica para bucear hasta **18 metros**.

Antes de la parte práctica debes completar la teoría en **PADI eLearning**, que toma aproximadamente **10 a 12 horas**. El curso incluye sesiones en piscina y **4 inmersiones en aguas abiertas**.

No se puede ir y volver a Cartagena cada día: deben alojarse al menos **una noche en las islas**, después del primer día. El alojamiento no está incluido y se reserva directamente con el hotel. Saliendo desde Cartagena, el primer día se encuentran en el Muelle de la Bodeguita a las **8:00 a. m.**; el segundo día regresan a Cartagena en la lancha de las **3:00 p. m.**, con llegada aproximada a las **4:15 p. m.** El almuerzo está incluido el primer día, no el segundo.

También necesitas:
• Para cursos o minicursos se requiere el formulario médico: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-curso-en-espanol. El enlace se puede enviar junto con el de la reserva; si no lo has completado, te llega otra vez en el correo de confirmación de la reserva. Excepción: el refresher (repaso con instructor) usa el formulario médico de curso, aunque seas buzo certificado.
• Para procesar el seguro, debes completar el formato que te enviamos en el correo de confirmación.
• Edad mínima: desde los 10 años.
• Qué llevar: bañador, toalla, crema de sol, gafas de sol y ropa cómoda. El equipo de buceo o de snorkel va incluido en las salidas de buceo, el minicurso, el snorkel y los cursos PADI; en el Divemaster se usa equipo propio.

¿Saldrías *desde Cartagena* o ya estás *en las Islas del Rosario*? Así te paso el plan exacto. 🌊

rag.query: ¿Cómo es el curso Open Water con ustedes? ¿Cuántos días dura, hay que estudiar algo antes y se puede ir y volver a Cartagena cada día?
rag.answer:
¡Es una experiencia buenísima para empezar a bucear! El Open Water dura **2 días** y te certifica para bucear hasta **18 metros**.

Antes de la parte práctica debes completar la teoría en **PADI eLearning**, que toma aproximadamente **10 a 12 horas**. El curso incluye sesiones en piscina y **4 inmersiones en aguas abiertas**.

No se puede ir y volver a Cartagena cada día: deben alojarse al menos **una noche en las islas**, después del primer día. El alojamiento no está incluido y se reserva directamente con el hotel. Saliendo desde Cartagena, el primer día se encuentran en el Muelle de la Bodeguita a las **8:00 a. m.**; el segundo día regresan a Cartagena en la lancha de las **3:00 p. m.**, con llegada aproximada a las **4:15 p. m.** El almuerzo está incluido el primer día, no el segundo.

También necesitas:
• Para cursos o minicursos se requiere el formulario médico: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-curso-en-espanol. El enlace se puede enviar junto con el de la reserva; si no lo has completado, te llega otra vez en el correo de confirmación de la reserva. Excepción: el refresher (repaso con instructor) usa el formulario médico de curso, aunque seas buzo certificado.
• Para procesar el seguro, debes completar el formato que te enviamos en el correo de confirmación.
• Edad mínima: desde los 10 años.
• Qué llevar: bañador, toalla, crema de sol, gafas de sol y ropa cómoda. El equipo de buceo o de snorkel va incluido en las salidas de buceo, el minicurso, el snorkel y los cursos PADI; en el Divemaster se usa equipo propio.

¿Quieres que te comparta el enlace para ver fechas y reservar el curso?

rag.query: Nos gustaría hacerlo el miércoles 2 y el jueves 3 de diciembre, saliendo desde Cartagena. ¿Qué incluye el precio y qué tendríamos que pagar aparte?
rag.answer:
¡Qué buen plan! El Curso Open Water incluye la tarifa de ingreso al Parque Nacional Natural, seguro de buceo obligatorio, lancha rápida Cartagena–Islas–Cartagena, entrenamiento en piscina, 4 inmersiones de certificación con instructor PADI, equipo de buceo, almuerzo el primer día, tarjeta de certificación PADI y un aporte eco-social a DIVE TO HEAL.

Aparte tendrían que pagar el alojamiento en las islas para la noche del miércoles; el almuerzo del segundo día, el transporte terrestre hasta el muelle, fotos o videos submarinos y cualquier comida adicional son opcionales y no están incluidos. Las propinas también son voluntarias. El primer día se encuentran a las 8:00 a. m. en el Muelle de la Bodeguita; el segundo día regresan a Cartagena en la lancha de las 3:00 p. m., con llegada aproximada a las 4:15 p. m.

¿Desde dónde saldrías? Este plan dura 2 días y hay que *dormir en las islas* (el alojamiento no está incluido): puedes salir *desde Cartagena* el primer día o, si ya estás *en las islas*, coordinamos la recogida en tu hotel.

msg: ¿Hasta cuándo tenemos tiempo para reservar? Todavía estamos terminando de armar el viaje.
reply:
Pueden reservar más adelante; para esas fechas, el sistema permite elegirlas en el enlace de reserva. La fecha y las personas se seleccionan allí, y al reservar online tienen un 10% de descuento.

El sistema cierra a las **4:30 p. m. del día anterior** a la actividad. Para el **miércoles 2 de diciembre**, podrían reservar hasta el martes 1 a las 4:30 p. m.; para el **jueves 3**, hasta el miércoles 2 a las 4:30 p. m. La reserva se paga completa en la web con tarjeta extranjera, usando el pasaporte como documento de identificación.

[Reservar el Curso Open Water](https://book.divingplanet.org/book/basic-course/4?language=es)

Edad mínima 10 años salvo que se indique otra.
Operamos todos los días del año salvo el 25 de diciembre y el 1 de enero. Tú no ves los cupos: el cliente elige la fecha y el número de personas en el calendario del link de reserva.
Descuentos: 10% de descuento reservando online directamente con nosotros a través de la página web, no a través de terceros como PADI. Este es el descuento online estándar y se aplica automáticamente al reservar por la web. 10% de descuento para grupos de 5 personas o más, que se suma al 10% de descuento online (20% total reservando online). No aplica automáticamente: el grupo debe contactar al equipo para aplicarlo. Hay que pedirlo al equipo ANTES de pagar: si el grupo paga sin haberlo pedido, pierde el descuento (no se devuelve después). Aplica a buceo recreativo, minicurso, snorkel y al plan de acompañante; no aplica a cursos PADI. El acompañante (quien va en la lancha sin bucear ni hacer snorkel) cuenta como una persona más del grupo para llegar a 5 y también tiene el descuento de grupo. 5% de descuento si traes tu propio equipo COMPLETO (regulador, BCD/chaleco, traje, máscara, aletas, etc.), solo en buceo recreativo y cursos PADI: no aplica al minicurso ni al snorkel, aunque traigas el equipo completo. Tampoco aplica si solo traes parte del equipo. Los clientes colombianos y residentes en Colombia pagan en pesos colombianos (COP). Los clientes internacionales pagan en dólares (USD). No hay un descuento especial por ser colombiano; el precio es el mismo, solo cambia la moneda. Los descuentos no son acumulables excepto en casos especiales autorizados por el staff o donde se indique explícitamente lo contrario (ej: grupo + online sí se suman; equipo propio + online también). El de grupo y el de equipo propio NO se suman entre sí: cada uno se suma solo al online.
Moneda: los colombianos (vivan donde vivan) y los residentes en Colombia pagan en COP y el resto en USD; es el mismo precio en las dos monedas. El precio en COP de cada plan es el precio para colombianos: una respuesta que da ese precio 'para colombianos' es correcta. Lo que no existe es un descuento ni una tarifa rebajada para colombianos.
Profundidad máxima de cada buzo según su certificación (también en las salidas de buceo): Curso Básico PADI (Open Water): hasta 18 m; Curso Avanzado PADI: hasta 30 m.
Origen: si el contexto no dice desde dónde sale el cliente, da el precio desde Cartagena y el de 'ya en las islas', cada uno rotulado, o pregúntale desde dónde saldría.
